data.name: Bleeding Critical (Mythic)
data.description: Your deadliest blows unleash rivers of blood.

raw_tokens.value: Your deadliest blows unleash rivers of blood.

The bleed damage dealt with Bleeding Critical increases by %1. Stopping this bleed damage requires a Heal check with a DC equal to %2. Any magical healing ends the bleed damage normally.&nl;You can expend one use of mythic power to deal 1 Con bleed, in addition to the hit point bleed damage you deal with this feat. This effect increases by 1 for each additional use of mythic power you expend.|MythicLevel|15+HalfMythicLevel
